en.summary: This commit narrows the L1 MSHR refill-response ID field inside the bundle definition, but nearby code does not establish a concrete behavioral fix. In context it looks like interface cleanup within a wider two-step width refactoring, not a standalone DUT bug fix suitable for fault injection.
why_it_counts: Touches the central L1 MSHR DUT file.
Changes the declared width formula of the refill-response ID field.
disqualifiers: On this commit the MSHR IO still instantiates MSHRmissRspIn with bABits, so the caller-side width source remains unchanged until the follow-up commit.
The refill producer already sends only the MSHR-entry slice of d_source, and the MSHR consumer already uses the value as a narrow entry index.
No test, assertion, or adjacent control/data-path repair shows a real miss-completion behavior bug being fixed by this standalone patch.
evidence: L1MSHR.scala changes MSHRmissRspIn.instrId from UInt(bABits.W) to UInt(log2Up(NEntry).W).

In the same file around the commit, MSHR.io.missRspIn is still declared as new MSHRmissRspIn(bABits); that caller change only appears in follow-up commit 74303efc013eb94b4d2ab193f51738c13ee9ce6d on this branch.
DCache.scala drives missRspIn.bits.instrId from d_source(SetIdxBits+log2Up(NMshrEntry)-1, SetIdxBits), which is already an entry-index slice rather than an address-width token.
L1MSHR.scala assigns io.missRspIn.bits.instrId into entryMatchMissRsp, whose width is log2Up(NMshrEntry).

zh.summary: 该提交把 L1 MSHR 回填响应 ID 在 bundle 定义中的位宽收窄了，但结合周边代码看，并没有建立出明确的行为级修复证据。放在上下文里，它更像是一次两步位宽整理中的接口清理，而不是适合做故障注入的数据集级 DUT bug fix。
why_it_counts: 修改发生在核心 L1 MSHR DUT 文件中。
补丁确实修改了回填响应 ID 字段的声明位宽公式。
disqualifiers: 在这个提交里，MSHR IO 仍然用 bABits 去实例化 MSHRmissRspIn，因此调用侧的位宽来源直到后续提交才真正改掉。
回填响应的生产侧本来就只发送 d_source 中表示 MSHR 表项的切片，而消费侧本来也把该值当作窄位宽表项索引使用。
补丁本身没有配套测试、断言或相邻控制/数据路径修复来证明它单独修复了真实的 miss 完成行为错误。
evidence: L1MSHR.scala 把 MSHRmissRspIn.instrId 从 UInt(bABits.W) 改成了 UInt(log2Up(NEntry).W)。
同文件中该提交附近的 MSHR.io.missRspIn 仍然声明为 new MSHRmissRspIn(bABits)；本分支上的调用侧修正只在后续提交 74303efc013eb94b4d2ab193f51738c13ee9ce6d 中出现。
DCache.scala 用 d_source(SetIdxBits+log2Up(NMshrEntry)-1, SetIdxBits) 驱动 missRspIn.bits.instrId，这本来就已经是表项索引切片，而不是地址宽度令牌。
L1MSHR.scala 把 io.missRspIn.bits.instrId 赋给 entryMatchMissRsp，而后者的位宽是 log2Up(NMshrEntry)。
